definitions: A technique in machine learning where an attacker attempts to bypass a model's detection by making subtle, often imperceptible, changes to input data.
The act of an adversary successfully avoiding detection or classification by a system, typically through carefully crafted inputs.
examples: Researchers are developing new defenses against adversarial evasion.
The system's vulnerability to adversarial evasion was a major concern.
Adversarial evasion poses a significant threat to AI security.
